capabilities: link selected Jira issue keys to Jira web URLs
link issues to local issue notes, creating missing paths
support multiple Jira instances with a default
prompt for an issue key when nothing is selected
extras: README references a demo (removed in text) and notes setup requirements such as configuring the Jira instance URL and local issue directory.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert a plain Jira issue key into a clickable link to the issue in Jira or in a local notes folder.
summary: Jira integration that turns selected Jira issue keys into links to a Jira instance's web URL or a local issue note.
